output.summary: KEP-566 proposed making CoreDNS the default cluster DNS for Kubernetes, replacing kube-dns, after CoreDNS reached GA in v1.11. The KEP is marked implemented and stable.
output.rationale: CoreDNS was already GA in Kubernetes v1.11 and installable as an alternative to kube-dns in several tools. The proposal aimed to make it the default for the remaining install tools (kube-up, kops, minikube) and to provide a process for updating its image. The status is implemented and stable, but the excerpt provided does not describe the implementation steps or outcome.

alternatives.option: Keep kube-dns as the default and leave CoreDNS as an optional install alternative
alternatives.why_not: The excerpt states the purpose of the proposal is to make CoreDNS the default DNS, replacing kube-dns. The excerpt gives no reason this alternative was chosen.

evidence.quote: the purpose of this proposal is to make CoreDNS as the default DNS for Kubernetes, replacing kube-dns.
